verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page directly claims you can run CI/CD workflows using hosted or private runners, or both, with centralized visibility across pipeline status, testing policies and deployment environments (docs-8, docs-27). Bitbucket Pipelines is the built-in CI/CD tool behind this (docs-18). The evidence is only marketing-level copy from a single product page, missing for 10: in-depth runner setup/configuration documentation, details of the centralized visibility dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration of private runner usage.
